scientificAssessment.reasoning: Reviewed UniProt function, location and domain annotations distinguish AR DNA- and ligand-binding regions and qualify nuclear localization. The caption explicitly refuses ER identity or indication transfer, and separates amount, location, transcription and growth dependence.
